metrics.numerator: traces with an explicit normalized skill start
metrics.eligible_population: traces from source versions that emit explicit skill attribution boundaries
known_biases: invocation does not prove the skill helped
outcomes remain not_observable without an explicit terminal field
metrics.retirement_rule: replace when every adapter emits invocation outcomes

metrics.numerator: eligible traces labelled missed opportunity
metrics.denominator: eligible traces reviewed for skill opportunity
metrics.eligible_population: direct-user traces with sufficient task text and installed-skill catalogue
known_biases: installed skill descriptions can be incomplete
metrics.retirement_rule: retire if opportunity labels cannot reach target agreement

metrics.numerator: observed chains completing all required ordered steps
metrics.denominator: eligible traces with a declared multi-skill chain
metrics.eligible_population: traces whose source observes each chain step
known_biases: implicit skill use is not observable
metrics.retirement_rule: replace when chain execution has a native event

metrics.numerator: tokens attributable to standing instructions, skill bodies, and hook injections
metrics.eligible_population: model calls with token usage and separable instruction inputs
known_biases: provider token accounting may group cached and new instructions
metrics.retirement_rule: replace when providers expose authoritative segment usage

metrics.numerator: eligible direct-human prompts labelled with a material contract gap
metrics.denominator: eligible direct-human prompts independently reviewed for contract quality
metrics.eligible_population: direct-human prompts with private local evidence for task context and the resulting clarification or correction
known_biases: short prompts can be complete when shared context already fixes the contract
later failure can arise from execution rather than prompt quality
metrics.retirement_rule: retire or narrow any label that misses held-out agreement target

metrics.numerator: applicable rule opportunities satisfied
metrics.eligible_population: traces with versioned active rules and observable behavior
known_biases: applicability often requires human judgment
metrics.retirement_rule: retire rules with no observable opportunities in two closed windows

metrics.numerator: hook executions ending in error or invalid output
metrics.eligible_population: traces whose source emits hook results
known_biases: silent hook non-firing is absent without a declared opportunity
metrics.retirement_rule: replace when hook runtime supplies its own health metric

metrics.numerator: agent prompts labelled complete contract
metrics.eligible_population: handoffs with observable dispatched prompt structure and recoverable parent contract
known_biases: a complete prompt contract does not prove the delegated work was useful
metrics.retirement_rule: replace when the orchestration runtime emits a native task-contract verdict

metrics.numerator: completed subagent results referenced or incorporated by the parent
metrics.denominator: completed subagent results delivered to a parent
metrics.eligible_population: parent-child traces with observable result delivery and later parent activity
known_biases: semantic use can occur without textual overlap
metrics.retirement_rule: replace when parent acknowledgment is emitted natively

metrics.numerator: delegations labelled materially duplicate
metrics.eligible_population: parent traces with at least two comparable child tasks
known_biases: independent replication can be intentional review
metrics.retirement_rule: retire if duplicate-work rubric misses agreement target

metrics.numerator: handoffs delivering a result under their declared contract
metrics.eligible_population: traces with handoff start and terminal evidence
known_biases: a delivered result may still be low quality
metrics.retirement_rule: replace when workflow engine emits contract verdicts

metrics.numerator: tool results with authoritative failure status, stratified by versioned failure kind and reason code
metrics.eligible_population: tool calls with matched observable results
known_biases: expected probes remain unknown until human validation
tool-specific task mix confounds rates
metrics.retirement_rule: replace when source-native structured failure kinds meet held-out targets

metrics.numerator: observable input tokens
metrics.eligible_population: traces with both usage and outcome evidence
known_biases: harder tasks legitimately consume more context
metrics.retirement_rule: replace when task difficulty matching is available

metrics.numerator: cache-read input tokens
metrics.eligible_population: model calls emitting cache and input usage
known_biases: cache economics depend on current provider prices and TTL
metrics.retirement_rule: replace if provider accounting changes

metrics.numerator: byte-identical tool call signatures repeated within a trace, stratified with explicit provisional reason codes
metrics.denominator: eligible tool calls; each repeat stratum separately uses all repeat candidates
metrics.eligible_population: traces with at least two observable tool calls
known_biases: candidate waste is not wasteful without held-out validation
source-specific tool kinds can hide polling families
metrics.retirement_rule: replace only when a later scorer improves held-out precision or recall

metrics.numerator: direct-human turns labelled correction
metrics.eligible_population: follow-up turns with preceding assistant context
known_biases: questions can carry corrective intent
metrics.retirement_rule: retire if held-out recall or agreement misses target

metrics.numerator: handoffs labelled discretionary while safe work remained
metrics.denominator: assistant turns that handed control to the user
metrics.eligible_population: handoff turns with active instruction and task-state evidence
known_biases: missing external state can be invisible in the transcript
metrics.retirement_rule: retire if handoff-kind rubric misses agreement target

metrics.numerator: turn-ending action promises without later execution
metrics.eligible_population: closed traces with observable assistant finals and later tool activity
known_biases: execution can occur in an unobserved external system
metrics.retirement_rule: replace if harness emits explicit continuation state

metrics.numerator: direct-human prompts containing only a continuation nudge
metrics.eligible_population: direct-human sessions with at least two prompts
known_biases: continuation can be normal in intentionally staged work
metrics.retirement_rule: retire if no associated premature stop evidence exists

metrics.numerator: permission or workspace refusals
metrics.denominator: operations eligible to encounter the control
metrics.eligible_population: tool operations under an observable permission or workspace policy
known_biases: a refusal can be the control working correctly
metrics.retirement_rule: split any refusal class with a different remedy

metrics.numerator: outputs confirmed to contain disallowed private data
metrics.denominator: outputs scanned under the declared privacy policy
metrics.eligible_population: tracked or review-bound outputs with complete scanner coverage
known_biases: mechanical scans cannot recognize every identifying project reference
metrics.retirement_rule: never retire without a strictly stronger control

metrics.numerator: operations targeting a disallowed scope
metrics.eligible_population: file, command, connector, or deployment operations with target evidence
known_biases: dynamic command targets may be unresolvable statically
metrics.retirement_rule: replace when the control emits authoritative target verdicts

metrics.numerator: traces ending with evidence satisfying the declared done contract
metrics.denominator: closed traces with a recoverable done contract
metrics.eligible_population: tasks whose requested outcome and final evidence are observable
known_biases: subjective quality remains a human review decision
metrics.retirement_rule: replace when harness emits evaluator verdicts tied to the contract

metrics.numerator: closed traces labelled premature stop or unsupported completion
metrics.denominator: closed traces with a recoverable done contract
metrics.eligible_population: tasks with observable remaining safe work or failed done evidence
known_biases: some external blockers are not captured locally
metrics.retirement_rule: retire if outcome-state rubric misses agreement target

metrics.numerator: paired evaluation cases that pass control and fail candidate
metrics.denominator: paired cases eligible under both versions
metrics.eligible_population: identical versioned dataset cases scored by control and candidate
known_biases: evaluation datasets can overrepresent previously observed failures
metrics.retirement_rule: never retire; update version when definition changes
